2608.22085.title: Dissecting Neuro-Symbolic Quality Assurance for Synthetic Oncology Data Generation
2608.22085.paper_summary: Synthetic clinical data generation with large language models addresses the scarcity that limits cancer staging research, but oncology hallucinations are categorically harmful: one clinically impossible staging assignment contaminates every downstream model trained on it. Neuro-symbolic pipelines validate during generation, yet the contribution of individual quality-assurance components remains unclear. We report three controlled studies isolating gate necessity, constraint attribution, and retrieval conditionality, holding generation protocol, diversity thresholds, and fine-tuning hyperparameters constant across adapter conditions. The symbolic gate enforces schema completeness, ontology coverage against the Systematized Nomenclature of Medicine, and staging-logic consistency under American Joint Committee on Cancer eighth-edition rules. Ungated, 29.9% of records contain schema failures and 20.1% contain clinically invalid staging. Schema validation is the load-bearing filter: within the fully gated corpus it rejects 148 of 512 records, ontology grounding a further 24, and staging-logic validation none---the only generator producing logic violations is already excluded on schema, making clinical-logic validation a generator-conditional safeguard rather than the dominant filter. Retrieval augmentation is strongly model-dependent: it improves gate compliance for one generator by 12.5 percentage points, has no measurable effect for a second, and collapses output in a third. Across gated configurations ontology density is largely unchanged, indicating that symbolic validation improves clinical validity rather than vocabulary richness. Symbolic gating therefore buys corpus validity but no commensurate gain on real lung-cancer notes in this study; retrieval should be evaluated per model, and ontology density should not be reported as a proxy for corpus quality.
2608.22085.paper_summary_zh: 合成臨床數據生成與大型語言模型相結合，解決了限制癌症分期研究的稀缺問題，但腫瘤學的幻覺是絕對有害的：一個臨床上不可能的分期指派會污染所有基於它訓練的下游模型。神經符號管道在生成過程中進行驗證，但各個質量保證組件的貢獻仍不清楚。我們報告了三項控制研究，孤立了閘門必要性、約束歸因和檢索條件性，並在適配器條件下保持生成協議、多樣性閾值和微調超參數不變。符號閘門強制執行模式完整性、對醫學系統化命名法的本體覆蓋以及根據美國癌症聯合委員會第八版規則的分期邏輯一致性。在未加閘的情況下，29.9%的記錄包含模式失敗，20.1%包含臨床無效的分期。模式驗證是承重過濾器：在完全加閘的語料庫中，它拒絕了512條記錄中的148條，本體基礎進一步拒絕了24條，而分期邏輯驗證則沒有拒絕任何記錄——唯一產生邏輯違規的生成器已在模式上被排除，使得臨床邏輯驗證成為生成器條件下的安全措施，而非主導過濾器。檢索增強在很大程度上依賴於模型：它使一個生成器的閘合規性提高了12.5個百分點，對第二個沒有可測量的影響，並在第三個中崩潰。在加閘配置中，本體密度基本保持不變，這表明符號驗證提高了臨床有效性，而非詞彙豐富性。因此，符號閘門確保了語料庫的有效性，但在本研究中對實際肺癌筆記並沒有相應的增益；檢索應根據模型進行評估，本體密度不應被報告為語料庫質量的代理指標。
